entry.title: [様子見] npm: Mongoose: Discriminator key values matching inherited properties (e.g. __t: 'constructor') bypass schema casting and can poison collections (MEDIUM)
entry.content:
Claudeの仕分け：様子見 Mongooseのdiscriminatorキーで型変換をすり抜けられる。MEDIUM
→ mongooseを6.13.12 / 7.8.13 / 8.24.7 / 9.11.4 に更新

mongoose < 6.13.12 → 6.13.12, mongoose >= 7.0.0, < 7.8.13 → 7.8.13, mongoose >= 8.0.0, < 8.24.7 → 8.24.7, mongoose >= 9.0.0, < 9.11.4 → 9.11.4

CVE-2026-125116

entry.title: [要確認] npm: Mongoose: Connection-level sanitizeFilter not applied (HIGH)
entry.content:
Claudeの仕分け：要確認 Mongooseで接続単位のsanitizeFilterが効かない。設定している場合に影響
→ sanitizeFilterの設定を確認し、6.13.12 / 7.8.13 / 8.24.7 / 9.11.4 に更新

mongoose >= 6.0.0, < 6.13.12 → 6.13.12, mongoose >= 7.0.0, < 7.8.13 → 7.8.13, mongoose >= 8.0.0, < 8.24.7 → 8.24.7, mongoose >= 9.0.0, < 9.11.4 → 9.11.4

entry.content:

entry.content:
